The issuer has positive profitability (net margin ~9.8% and EBIT margin ~18%) and a solid capital base (shareholders’ equity ~2,467M), but leverage is relatively high with total liabilities of ~5,146M (~68% of total assets). Liquidity is also weak, with current assets of 664M below current liabilities of 800M (current ratio ~0.83), which constrains short-term financial flexibility.  

DECISION: BBB-
